name: manual_a040ee
claim: Guard every bash for-loop over an array built with += with an if ((${#arr[@]})); then ... fi count check before iterating

decisions.notes: macOS default bash 3.2.57 aborts with 'unbound variable' under set -u when iterating a zero-element array, even in code paths meant to legitimately no-op on empty input. Hit 3x this session: mapfile, then check_tdd_commit.sh's staged array (PR #355) silently ate an amend command.

rationale: macOS default bash 3.2.57 aborts with 'unbound variable' under set -u when iterating a zero-element array, even in code paths meant to legitimately no-op on empty input. Hit 3x this session: mapfile, then check_tdd_commit.sh's staged array (PR #355) silently ate an amend command.
